meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览上游更新,挑选合入定制安装
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果维护着定制版NanoClaw,想便捷同步官方更新
copy.tagline_en: Preview upstream updates and cherry-pick them into your customized install
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized NanoClaw and want to sync official updates

howto.what: 装上后，运行 /update-nanoclaw 时 Claude 会先检查 git 工作区是否干净，创建带时间戳的备份分支和标签，再预览上游 NanoClaw 的更新并分类；然后让你选择合并、只挑部分提交或变基，帮你解决冲突，运行构建和测试，检查破坏性变更，最后打印回滚命令。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中输入 /update-nanoclaw 命令时触发；若 git 工作区有未提交改动，会先要求你提交或暂存再继续。

say.text: 帮我更新 NanoClaw 到最新上游版本
say.note: Claude 会执行完整更新流程。

say.text: 用 /update-nanoclaw 只挑我选的提交
say.note: 进入选择性挑拣模式，先列提交给你选。

say.text: 先预览 /update-nanoclaw 会带来哪些改动
say.note: 只看预览和分类，不实际合并。

howto.what_en: Running /update-nanoclaw: checks git status, backs up via branch+tag, previews upstream changes, offers merge/cherry-pick/rebase, resolves conflicts, builds/tests, checks breaking changes, prints rollback info.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs /update-nanoclaw in Claude Code. It also applies when you have a customized NanoClaw install and want to pull upstream updates.

say_en.text: Update NanoClaw to the latest upstream version
say_en.note: Claude will run the full update flow.

say_en.text: Use /update-nanoclaw but only pick the commits I choose
say_en.note: Selective cherry-pick mode; commits are listed for you.
Only shows preview and categories, no merge.
